criteria: Journal-article metadata independently checked against Crossref by DOI; distinct DOIs; candidates limited to peer-reviewed journal publications with direct relevance to public finance, fiscal decentralization, municipal/subnational revenue, expenditure, transfers, institutions, accountability, service provision, and Belgian/EU fiscal governance. Working papers, reports, books, theses, datasets, preprints, and tangential matches excluded.
coverage_note: No DOI-bearing peer-reviewed journal articles specifically about Arcoverde or Araripina were identified in the scholarly-index search. The Brazil-focused records therefore provide national, regional (including Northeast/semi-arid), and municipal evidence for adapting the comparison; they should not be represented as town-specific findings. Belgian/EU-specific journal literature is narrower than the Brazilian and comparative local-finance literature.
